All manifest/provenance identity comparisons passed; canonical digests were a6c0ad16ef85530b00a79e13f644d0275ff03a10d9efd89a1ff644fbf0090ab8 and 4f9ec0833062cad5a7546998cd50978af81b8f68c584a057bd75d59920a9a8c0.

The submitted verifier, JSON parses, shell syntax check, and Python AST parse exited 0; the independent narrow credential scan found no matching private-key, common token-prefix, or URL-userinfo pattern.

probe.c compiled dynamically with GCC 8.5.0, ran with exit 0, exposed CHECK=independent-review, and returned the requested status 17. Static fixture creation exited 1 because the linker could not find -lc, reproducing the submitted limitation.

Static review found that direct __tinycontainer_init argv dispatch can reach mount/hostname/chroot setup without proving the parent created fresh namespaces, and that ParseRunArgs does not enforce the required -- separator.
Documentation, non-goals, disposable-host warnings, dependency-free modules, deterministic planning boundary, and learner-facing conceptual sequence are otherwise clear and useful.
limitations: No Go, gofmt, gccgo, or TinyGo executable was available. Every attempted Go build, test, and benchmark exited 127, so compilation and Go behavior remain unverified.
The static C runtime archive was unavailable, so no self-contained rootfs was produced and namespace, mount, chroot, cancellation, signal, and integration behavior was not executed.

Git and shellcheck were unavailable. The recorded source commit/tree, catalog license, and assertion that linked content was not copied could not be checked against an external source snapshot; network fallback was not used.

No factory-produced learner view was present. Path organization was inspectable, but exclusion of the 25 co-resident solution-bearing sealed files from an actual student transfer remains inconclusive.
Credential matching was a bounded heuristic, not proof that no sensitive information exists.
